data.en: Last draw was 12, 18, 32, 45, 47, 49, special 41, with no first-prize winner. In the last 100 draws, 7 appeared 22 times, the most frequent, while 39 appeared only 4 times, the least, and 38 appeared 5 times. Tail 7 appeared 77 times, the most, tail 0 appeared 49 times, the least. Zone 1-10 appeared 130 times, 11-20 135 times, 21-30 120 times, 31-40 109 times, 41-49 106 times. Average sum was 144.8, average span 34.4, consecutive-number rate 50%. The key this time is not to chase numbers that just appeared: 47 and 49 just appeared, with 45, 46 and 48 close by, so chasing them would only chase heat. This time both 47 and 49 are avoided entirely to let them cool. Numbers that appear too often should be eased back, so 7 is kept only in the second group for balance; numbers that appear too rarely should be brought back, so 39 is brought back to fill the cold gap. Tails must balance: first group tails 5, 2, 3, 1, 9, 4, second group 7, 0, 8, 4, 6, 3, ten tails together. The weakest zone 41-49 must be filled, with 44 in the first group and 43 in the second, not with 47 or 49. First group 5, 12, 23, 31, 39, 44, sum 154, span 39; second group 7, 10, 28, 34, 36, 43, sum 158, span 36. Key picks are 39 to fill the cold gap, 36 to fill tail 6, and 43 to fill zone 41-49 while avoiding just-drawn 47 and 49. 本期2組：5,12,23,31,39,44、7,10,28,34,36,43

The Death Gate falls on tail 0, controlled by 40, which restores tail 0. Emptiness falls on 38, which means it must be filled, and 38, with only 5 appearances, is a cold number used in the first group to fill the emptiness. First group 1, 13, 24, 33, 39, 40, sum 150, span 39, key picks 39 to turn fortune, 40 to fill tail 0, and 1 to open a new cycle; second group 2, 15, 26, 37, 38, 44, sum 162, span 42, key picks 38 to fill cold, 44 to fill high zone, and 37 to steady the centre.
